versions.changelog:
- Updated the pricing section to clarify differences between human (SaaS subscription) and agent (per-action USDC) usage, with two distinct pricing models.
- Expanded and detailed the tools list and included more information on payment rails and per-action pricing for agents.
- Updated per-tool pricing and payment methods, reflecting new cost details for additional analytics and intelligence tools.
- Removed README.md file.

### Version 1.1.1

- Added a README.md file with documentation or usage instructions.
- No changes to code or functionality.

Initial release of the jubjub skill.

- Publish content to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, Vimeo, Vimeo OTT, and Mux from a single workflow.
- Manage teams, collaborate with threaded messaging, and track on-chain verified publish history.
- Includes full API toolset for content, workspace, launch, team, and invite management.
- Supports multi-tier pricing, including free, Creator, and Studio plans, plus per-action payment options.
- Every publish is recorded on-chain for verifiable proof of ownership.
- X/Twitter is not currently supported.
